Meeting Overview & Source Audit
Source Audit Trail & Age
Calendar: Confirmed (16:00 UTC) | Email: 21 Aug (3d old) | Drive: 12 Aug (12d old) | GitHub: Live
Prior Context & Key Decisions
• Contract renewal offer is $48,000/yr contingent on SSO commitment by 18 September.
• Jordan is running Northstar security review; promised implementation date at today's call.
• Product design sync closed #2042 (button moved to foot) and opened #2040 (domain login).
• Investor review requests metrics on the 100-person waitlist, weekly burn, and activation.
Sources: Drive doc-northstar (12 Aug), Email from Maya (21 Aug), GitHub #2040, #2042

• Issue #2077: Northstar SSO security review (Assigned: Priya, Status: Open)
• Issue #412: Confirm SSO launch scope (Assigned: Jordan, Status: Open)

Missing & Uncertain Data Gaps
• Final SSO technical scope is pending confirmation from Jordan before checklist completion.
• Drive notes for Northstar are 12 days old (12 Aug); relying on 21 Aug email terms.
• Investor update meeting has no prior meeting notes in Drive; context comes only from email.
• Verification needed on whether 100-person waitlist activation meets 14 September goal.
Data Freshness Alert: Ensure all team members align on 28 Aug runbook & 2 Sep cutover
3 Key Points to Raise in Discussion
1. Commit to SSO delivery before 18 September
Confirm that our 14 September platform release satisfies Northstar's 18 September requirement
to lock in the $48,000 annual contract renewal without further review delay.
Source: Email from Maya (21 Aug) & Northstar call notes (12 Aug)
2. Hand off finalized SSO scope for Jordan's checklist
Provide Priya and Jordan the exact SSO scope definition so Jordan can unblock and finish the
security review checklist (tracked in Issue #412 and Issue #2077).
Source: Google Meet transcript (24 Aug) & GitHub Issue #412
3. Coordinate billing cutover with renewal timeline
Align the 2 September billing system transition with Northstar's renewal paperwork to ensure
invoicing continuity and eliminate billing discrepancy risks (Dana posting date by Tuesday).
Source: Launch review transcript (Dana)
